# Test fixtures: SBOM schemas

Official JSON Schemas for the SBOM formats fwtool writes, downloaded
2026-11-17 for offline validation in the test suite:

- bom-1.6.schema.json — CycloneDX 1.6 JSON schema
  https://cyclonedx.org/schema/bom-1.6.schema.json
- spdx-schema.json — SPDX 2.3 JSON schema
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/spdx/spdx-spec/support/2.3/schemas/spdx-schema.json

These are specification data files used only to validate output. They are
not part of the shipped tool.
